Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:67155: perl security update (Moderate)
Metadata.Description:
Perl is a high-level programming language that is commonly used for system administration utilities and web programming.

Security Fix(es):

* perl: Perl: Incorrect regular expression processing via large regular expressions (CVE-2026-13221)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
